steps.title: Prepare MitoTracker probe mix
steps.instruction: Calculate the number of wells to be stained and prepare a probe mix that provides 50 µL per well using PBS + 2 % FCS as diluent. Dilute MitoTracker™ Green stock (1 mM in DMSO) 1/100 in PBS, then dilute that 1/100 again into the mix to reach a final concentration of 100 nM. Dilute MitoTracker™ Red stock (1 mM in DMSO) 1/100 in PBS, then dilute that 1/50 into the mix to reach a final concentration of 50 nM. Add anti‑mouse F4/80 antibody (BioLegend clone BM8, Cat. 123,137) at 1/200 dilution and Live/Dead™ Fixable Aqua dead‑cell stain (ThermoFisher L34957) at 1/500 dilution. Bring the total volume to 50 µL per well with PBS + 2 % FCS and pre‑warm the mix to 37 °C.

substeps.instruction: Determine the total number of wells (including controls) and calculate the required volume (50 µL per well).
Dilute MitoTracker™ Green stock 1/100 in PBS, then dilute that 1/100 into the final mix (final 100 nM).
Dilute MitoTracker™ Red stock 1/100 in PBS, then dilute that 1/50 into the final mix (final 50 nM).
Add anti‑F4/80 antibody at 1/200 dilution.
Add Live/Dead™ Fixable Aqua at 1/500 dilution.
Adjust the volume with PBS + 2 % FCS to 50 µL per well.
Pre‑warm the complete probe mix at 37 °C.

steps.title: Set up control wells for MitoTracker
steps.instruction: Allocate one well as an unstained control and two wells as fluorescence‑minus‑one (FMO) controls: one lacking MitoTracker™ Green and one lacking MitoTracker™ Red. Add 50 µL of the appropriate FMO mix to each FMO well and 50 µL of PBS + 2 % FCS to the unstained well.

substeps.instruction: Add 50 µL PBS + 2 % FCS to the unstained control well.
Add 50 µL of the FMO‑Green mix (all dyes except MitoTracker™ Green) to its designated well.
Add 50 µL of the FMO‑Red mix (all dyes except MitoTracker™ Red) to its designated well.

steps.title: Harvest and wash macrophages
steps.instruction: In a 48‑well culture plate containing 3.5 × 10⁵ adherent macrophages per well, wash cells with cold PBS 1×, gently scrape them with a cell scraper, transfer the suspension to a 96‑well round‑bottom plate, centrifuge 5 min at 1500 rpm, and discard the supernatant.

substeps.instruction: Wash each well with cold PBS 1×.
Gently scrape the cells from the plate.
Transfer the cell suspension to a 96‑well round‑bottom plate.
Centrifuge for 5 min at 1500 rpm.
Discard the supernatant.

steps.title: Stain cells with MitoTracker mix
steps.instruction: Resuspend each cell pellet in 50 µL of the pre‑warmed MitoTracker probe mix (or the appropriate FMO mix) and incubate for 15 min at 37 °C.

substeps.instruction: Add 50 µL of the prepared probe mix to each well.
Add 50 µL of the corresponding FMO mix to the FMO wells.
Incubate the plate for 15 min at 37 °C.

steps.title: Wash stained cells
steps.instruction: Add 100 µL of warm PBS + 2 % FCS to each well, centrifuge 5 min at 1500 rpm, and discard the supernatant.

substeps.instruction: Add 100 µL warm PBS + 2 % FCS.
Centrifuge for 5 min at 1500 rpm.
Remove the supernatant.

steps.title: Resuspend for acquisition
steps.instruction: Resuspend the cell pellet in PBS + 2 % FCS (volume sufficient for flow cytometry) and acquire the samples on the flow cytometer immediately, especially for MitoTracker™ Green which is not fixable.

steps.title: Prepare MitoSOX probe mix
steps.instruction: Dilute MitoSOX™ Red stock (5 mM in DMSO) 1/10 in PBS, then dilute that 1/100 into the final mix to obtain a working concentration of 5 µM. Dilute anti‑mouse CD11b‑PE‑Cy7 antibody (BioLegend clone M1/70, Cat. 101,216) 1/200 and Live/Dead™ Calcein Blue (FisherScientific BDB564060) 1/500 in PBS + 2 % FCS. Bring the mix to 50 µL per well and pre‑warm to 37 °C.

substeps.instruction: Dilute MitoSOX™ Red stock 1/10 in PBS.
Dilute the resulting solution 1/100 into the final mix (final 5 µM).
Add anti‑CD11b antibody at 1/200 dilution.
Add Live/Dead™ Calcein Blue at 1/500 dilution.
Adjust volume with PBS + 2 % FCS to 50 µL per well.
Pre‑warm the mix at 37 °C.

steps.title: Set up control wells for MitoSOX
steps.instruction: Allocate one unstained control well and one FMO well (containing all dyes except MitoSOX™ Red). Add 50 µL of the appropriate mix to each control well.

substeps.instruction: Add 50 µL PBS + 2 % FCS to the unstained control well.
Add 50 µL of the MitoSOX‑FMO mix (all dyes except MitoSOX™ Red) to its designated well.

steps.title: Stain cells with MitoSOX mix
steps.instruction: Repeat the harvesting, washing, staining, and washing steps using the MitoSOX probe mix: resuspend cells in 50 µL pre‑warmed mix, incubate 15 min at 37 °C, wash with 100 µL warm PBS + 2 % FCS, centrifuge 5 min at 1500 rpm, discard supernatant, and finally resuspend in PBS + 2 % FCS for flow cytometry acquisition.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend cell pellet in 50 µL pre‑warmed MitoSOX mix (or FMO mix).
Incubate 15 min at 37 °C.
Add 100 µL warm PBS + 2 % FCS, centrifuge 5 min at 1500 rpm, discard supernatant.
Resuspend in PBS + 2 % FCS for acquisition.
